messages.subject: RE: Rattle Install. [SEC=UNOFFICIAL]

Good Morning,

 

I gather you have downloaded some of the files, because you can see rattle. It sounds like you need to reload the dependant packages, but use the main Cran server.

 

Graham updates the Rattle windows very recently, and the pictures may have changed a little than before the recent changes.

 

II might suggest that you reload the dependent packages again. But to download the Rattle from the Togaware site direct.

 

Regards

Tony
